name: elevenlabs
summary: Completed the ElevenLabs quickstart end-to-end. Installed the elevenlabs and python-dotenv packages, created the example.py script exactly as documented, and successfully generated a valid MP3 audio file (output.mp3, 43KB, MPEG ADTS layer III 128kbps 44.1kHz) from the text "The first move is what sets everything in motion." using the George voice (JBFqnCBsd6RMkjVDRZzb) and eleven_v3 model.
deviations: The quickstart's play(audio) function executed without error but cannot be audibly verified in a headless sandbox with no speakers. To verify the promised outcome (audio generation), I created a second script that writes the returned audio iterator to a file, confirming a real, valid MP3 was produced by the API.

verified.evidence: output.mp3: Audio file with ID3 version 2.4.0, contains: MPEG ADTS, layer III, v1, 128 kbps, 44.1 kHz, Monaural
